doc.title: Filler Lubrication and Valve Seal Inspection
doc.file: MP-501 Filler Lubrication and Valve Seal Inspection.pdf
doc.purpose: Keep the rotary fillers filling accurately by lubricating the carousel and catching worn valve seals.

roles.name: Operator
roles.does: Repeats the nozzle check in WI-210 after any seal change.

references.as_written: WI-210 Filler Setup and Nozzle Check

parameters.quote: EVERY 14 DAYS: LUBRICATION AND NOZZLE INSPECTION
Run the filler empty for 2 minutes and listen for noise.
Remove two valves, chosen from different sides of the carousel.

parameters.what: worn seal share that triggers full set replacement
parameters.quote: If more than a third are worn, replace the full set.

rules.statement: The Maintenance Technician removes the locks after the lubrication work.
rules.quote: Maintenance Technician: Remove locks. Run the filler empty for 2 minutes

rules.topic: who repeats the nozzle check after a seal change
rules.statement: After any seal change the operator, not the Maintenance Technician, repeats the WI-210 nozzle check before the line is released.
rules.quote: After any seal change, the operator repeats the nozzle check in WI-210 before the line is released.

rules.statement: The Shift Lead releases the line.

unsure.what: Step 4 of section 7.0 is written as a Maintenance Technician step but assigns the action to 'the operator'
unsure.why: Unclear who actually repeats the nozzle check; WI-210 has no 'repeat after seal change' step

unsure.what: Shift Lead, a role not used in the Line Lead procedures
unsure.why: May be the same person as the Line Lead; not stated
